differential.name: Chronic kidney disease, hypertensive/diabetic nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Persistent creatinine 2.8 mg/dL in an elderly hypertensive, obese patient with metabolic syndrome suggests longstanding CKD.

differential.name: Acute kidney injury secondary to cardiorenal syndrome (type 1)
differential.rationale: Recent NSTEMI can precipitate rapid renal function decline via reduced cardiac output and venous congestion.

differential.name: Contrast‑induced nephropathy
differential.rationale: Likely exposure to iodinated contrast during coronary angiography for NSTEMI; creatinine rise fits typical timeline.

differential.name: Acute tubular necrosis from hypotension or nephrotoxic drugs
differential.rationale: Possible peri‑procedural hypotension or NSAID/ACE‑I use in a patient with baseline CKD can cause ATN.

differential.name: Renal artery stenosis
differential.rationale: Hypertension refractory to therapy and abrupt renal function worsening raise suspicion for renovascular disease.
